zh-Hans.name: 言道国学
zh-Hans.subtitle: 原典图谱、易学研习与学习交流
zh-Hans.keywords: 古籍,原典,中医学习,经络,穴位,本草,三维人体,学习笔记,听学,离线阅读,历法,易学,学习交流
zh-Hans.description:
言道国学——把原典、图谱与学习同好连在一起。

言道国学把国学原典、中医文献、易学工具、天文历法与学习交流放在一起，让阅读、观察、练习和讨论相互连接。

读原典，也能复习：按书籍、篇章与关键词查找已收录资料，配合连续听学、学习笔记、章节练习和错题复习，逐步整理自己的知识。原典、课堂整理和编辑摘要分别注明来源；各书的底本与收录范围可在阅读页查看。

看结构，也看出处：在三维人体中旋转、缩放和分层观察，查看经络、穴位名称，联系已收录图谱、教材原页、动图和文献理解知识点。药材、穴位及经典配伍记载用于文献学习与对照。人体模型支持长按逐层观察、撤销恢复与返回上一级；独立侧栏与流动虚线方便观察。原模型经络与经典体表循行示意分别注明来源；未绘制的内部循行不作为精确三维定位展示。内置原四层图谱继续保留。

课程研读，留下自己的理解：在倪师自学专区按章节阅读课程文字整理、研习记录与补充著作，分别查看作者与来源，使用目录、全文查找、本机听学、阅读进度和个人学习笔记。课程保留原稿，另提供可回到原句的学习摘记、结构对照、阅读复习题与解析；支持收藏、原文批注和个人笔记导出。公共资料更新不会覆盖个人笔记。

一次准备，离线学习：完整中医学习资料包统一准备已收录的正文、原典、药穴资料和图像；正文与图谱向全部账号开放下载。三维人体按现有会员权益提供，会员可在同一次准备操作中补齐现行三维学习资源。支持检查并补齐资料，已保存内容可在离线时阅读。

用工具，也学原理：结合现有排盘工具、传统历法、节气与天文馆，了解相关术语、规则和传统文化背景，记录学习过程。易学原典标明所据版本，古代观点不作为现实预测或决策依据。

有问题，与同好交流：通过动态、评论、好友私信和学习群分享心得；在同辰雅集寻找自愿参与的学习同好，使用携盘交流与活盘链接讨论学习案例。分享前可选择内容与对象，支持举报、拉黑与退出。私人档案和分享资料继续受到授权控制。

听学也能选择声音：使用手机支持的中文音色进行本地听学，支持音色选择、试听、语速调整和连续播放。可用音色以设备实际安装的语音为准。

AI辅助内容会明确标识，使用时请对照原文与可靠资料。中医资料用于知识学习与文献研习；古籍记载、图谱示意及用户经历不可直接作为个人诊断、治疗或用药依据。本平台不提供医疗咨询，不为个人开方，不销售药品。

学习分享：使用分享码邀请同好了解学习内容；分享来源与安装、支付渠道分别记录，分享本身不产生奖励。学习与服务通知可直接关闭。

健康资料说明：本应用不是医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防疾病。涉及个人医疗决定，请咨询合格医疗专业人员。

iOS数字会员与AI点数通过App Store购买，会员页提供恢复购买。消耗型点数的已交付与余额以原应用账号账本为准，不把恢复购买说成重建已消费点数。
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 完善三维人体操作：设置与目录改为独立侧栏，操作模型后自动收起；模型操作区避免误触文字菜单，阅读资料仍可复制。改进体表遮挡与旋转照明，增加经络流动虚线和有出处的奇经体表循行示意。修正学习分享码与旧推广文字，新增可直接关闭的学习、服务纯文本通知。保留原四层模型、原经络动图、课程与学习交流。
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 把原典、图谱与学习同好连在一起。原典阅读与听学，三维人体、经络穴位及药材对照，配合课程摘记、来源定位、复习题和个人笔记，整理自己的学习。

en-US.name: 言道国学
en-US.subtitle: Classics, Anatomy & Study
en-US.promotionalText: Read Chinese classics, explore anatomy and meridian references, and study with source-linked extracts, review questions, personal notes and a learning community.
en-US.description:
Yandao Guoxue connects Chinese classical texts, illustrated references, cultural study tools and a learning community.

Read and revisit: Browse the included books by title, chapter and keyword. Original editions, lecture transcripts and editorial material are identified separately. Use supported on-device Chinese voices, playback controls and study notes to revisit what you read. Interface navigation supports multiple languages; the classical texts and lecture materials retain their original language.

Explore structure: Rotate, zoom and view layers of the anatomy model, follow meridian references and open related acupoint text, original pages and circulation animations. Side panels occupy their own area and close after model interaction. Flowing dashed routes distinguish existing model meridians from source-attributed classical external-path schematics; omitted internal routes are not presented as calibrated geometry. The existing four-layer viewer remains available. These are educational illustrations, not professionally validated clinical location or treatment tools.

Study courses: The teacher and supplementary-study area offers chapter reading, source-linked extracts, terminology in context, reading review questions with explanations, bookmarks, annotations and personal-note export. Each extract can return to its source. Public course updates do not replace your personal notes. Materials by other authors and students retain their own attribution.

Prepare once for offline reading: The complete Chinese-medicine learning pack groups included original texts, medicine/acupoint references and images. Text and illustration downloads are available to all signed-in accounts. Three-dimensional anatomy resources retain their existing membership requirements. Saved material remains available offline; account services and community features require a connection.

Study culture and calendars: Explore traditional calculation methods, terminology, seasonal calendars and astronomy as cultural learning tools. Historical views and AI explanations are not factual predictions of destiny, relationships, financial results or health.

Discuss with others: Use moderated posts, comments, friend messages and study groups. Voluntary adult Tongchen participation and chart sharing remain available with audience selection. Private records do not become public automatically. Reporting, blocking, withdrawal and account deletion remain available.

Optional digital membership and AI credits on iOS use App Store In-App Purchase. Restore Purchases is available in the membership area. Consumable-credit balances follow the original application account ledger; restoring does not recreate spent credits. Availability and entitlements are explained in the app.

AI-assisted content is marked and may be inaccurate. Check the original material and reliable sources. This is a learning platform, not a medical institution or a medical device. It does not provide individual medical consultation, diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions or drug sales. Historical medical texts, diagrams and user experiences are not personal medical or medication advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.

Ordinary study-sharing codes do not grant cash rewards or unlock paid features. Text-only learning and service notices can be dismissed immediately.
en-US.whatsNew: Improved anatomy controls with separate side panels that close after model interaction. Reduced accidental text-selection menus within model controls while keeping reading text selectable. Added flowing dashed meridians and separately attributed classical external-path schematics. Improved anatomy covering and rotating-view lighting. Corrected study-sharing copy and added dismissible text-only learning and service notices. Existing layers, original animations, courses and community features are retained.

reviewNotes:
言道国学25.0.119（61）延续原典、课程、中医文献、三维人体、易学与天文历法、完整学习交流功能。本次为操作与展示整改；不提供个人医疗咨询、诊断、处方或药品销售，不承诺命运、婚配、财富或健康预测。

本次变化：
1. 三维设置、组织与经络目录使用独立侧栏，不覆盖画布；操作模型后收起。仅模型操作区抑制长按文字菜单，正文与输入仍能复制。薄型体表遮挡、旋转填充光、虚线循行改善观察。
2. 原十四经络模型路线与新增六脉经典体表示意分别标识来源；依据所收录《奇经八脉考》章节展示有据外行段，省略内部及待核段。没有宣称专业医学校准、临床精准取穴或完整真人照片覆盖。保留原四层模型、原28幅经络动画与全部既有资料。
3. 学习分享码保留，但商店所有用户的固定渠道不展示官网现金推广、间接奖励或站外数字付费引导；分享不授予奖励或解锁付费权益。新推广、旧合同和历史账目分别处理，无审核员专用开关。
4. 增加可关闭的纯文本学习与服务通知。通知按公开的固定渠道、版本范围及有效时窗匹配，须本公司内容审核；默认未启动营销活动。关闭按钮立即可用，点击正文或背景及返回均可关闭，记住同修订并限制频次。通知不执行代码、不跳转购买、不改变支付或功能。

审核路径：
首页→中医学习→三维人体图谱：准备已有会员三维资料，进入模型；设置/组织/经络侧栏、循环/暂停、速度、原四层入口；选穴→详情→返回模型。
中医→倪师自学专区：课程、原课摘记、来源定位、复习、收藏与笔记导出。中医→典籍原文：查看出处并在应用内阅读。
我的→系统中心→离线内容→完整中医学习资料：一次准备已收录正文、图谱及原会员三维资料。正文与图谱全账号可下载，三维保留现有会员权益。
我的→学习分享码：复制分享码/学习链接。动态、评论、好友私信、学习群、同辰雅集、携盘分享及举报、拉黑、退出、注销仍可访问。海外iOS不强制中国手机号绑定；正常鉴权、隐私授权与内容过滤保留。
我的→会员中心/AI点数：沿用原8个App Store商品与恢复购买入口。消耗点数依原账号账本，不把恢复购买解释为重建已消费点数。沿用现有Apple私密审核账号字段，不在公开材料写入。

English review summary:
Version25.0.119(61) preserves the existing classical texts, courses, anatomy, cultural tools and moderated learning community. This update improves controls and presentation; it does not provide individual medical advice, diagnosis, prescriptions, drug sales or factual destiny predictions.

Anatomy now uses separate collapsible side panels, model-only text-action guards, improved covering and rotating-view lighting, and flowing dashed routes. Existing model routes and classical external-path schematics are attributed separately. Internal and unverified segments are omitted; there is no claim of clinical point accuracy. Original layers, animations and study sources remain available.

All users of the fixed App Store channel receive ordinary learning sharing, with no cash-promotion recruitment, indirect-reward promises or external digital-payment calls to action. Sharing does not unlock paid features. The documented notice feature displays reviewed learning/service text only, with fixed channel/version/date targeting, immediate dismissal and frequency limits. No marketing campaign is launched, and notices cannot execute code, open checkout or activate new functionality. No reviewer-specific switches are used.

The Chinese paths above cover anatomy, offline preparation, courses, texts, sharing, community and existing IAP. Existing private reviewer credentials and eight IAP identities are retained. Overseas iOS has no mandatory mainland-China phone binding. Restore Purchases does not recreate consumed credits.
credentials: Preserve the existing Apple private reviewer fields. Never publish or log them.
readiness: 本轮候选尚未构建、上传或正式提审，旧118审核保持。
